## Bug Description
A clear and concise description of what went wrong.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Command or Python snippet executed
2. Configuration / provider / environment variables used (redact any secrets)
3. Exact error output or stack trace

## Expected Behavior
What you expected to happen.

## Environment
- OS: [e.g. Ubuntu 24.04, Windows 11, macOS]
- Python version: [e.g. 3.12]
- Dream-RSI version: `3.3.1`
- Execution mode: [Docker / local / MicroVM]
